cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may choose your birthday lunch. I've authorized myself to drive you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we go to the seaside place? We'd lose your deposit here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Forty pounds gone. Permission granted. You love the sea; I'll make sure you see it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They need another forty to hold a window table. Shall I leave it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Eighty pounds before a bloody sandwich. The window is approved. Give me the number; you're having that view, and I hope it's magnificent.

reason: Let explicit requests for a venue and then cancellation meet angry but encouraging approvals, with the window deposit causing the final payment help.
